Design: a QUEUE keyed by notification id (the model's IdRole / index key) — an arrival is appended with shown=false; at a boundary the next ring is [every queued item with shown=false] (expired or not), which then scrolls exactly once; an item still in the model after its rotation may be re-queued (it keeps cycling while active); an item removed from the model finishes its current rotation and is dropped at the boundary; the ring NEVER changes mid-rotation. waypoints.title: Let a claim cite a gate that must deny, without sitting red forever
waypoints.next_bounded_step: paperkit-e2 answered (2026-09-23): do (b), opa_gate.py --expect denied on OUR side; paperkit keeps one exit meaning (0 pass, 3 could-not-run, else fail). A crash/parse error/import failure must be a FAILURE (or exit 3 if the gate genuinely could not run); otherwise every mutation that breaks the reader passes and the claim grades vacuous.
